snapshot.title: Add landscape-safe textarea constraints
snapshot.description: On landscape mobile (e.g., 667×375), the 300px `min-height` textarea + header (48px) + tabs (40px) + word counter (30px) = 418px, which overflows a 375px viewport. Need a landscape media query to reduce textarea min-height and ensure no overflow. Also adjust mobile prompt overlay `max-height` for landscape.
